todo1.title: TODO 1: calcAverage
whereToLook: The @return line gives the return type, and each @param line gives one parameter. calcAverage has five double parameters, each with its own type.
Day 2 notes, R1 (Sending the value back): a value-returning method ends with a return statement.
Day 2 notes, R2 (Using a return value): sum stores its result in a local variable, then returns it. You can also return the expression directly.

todo2.title: TODO 2: determineGrade
whereToLook: Day 2 notes, S1 (Returning a String): a method can send back a String the same way it sends back a number.
Check the highest range first with an if/else if chain, and use else for Fail.
Check the boundaries: 3.0 is Fail, 6.0 is Pass, 9.0 is Excel. Each range starts just above the number, so the checks use >, not >=.

todo3.title: TODO 3: isDangerous
whereToLook: Day 2 notes, B1 (A boolean return as a condition): isSafeAltitude returns a comparison, and main uses the call as an if condition.
A comparison like score > 9.0 is already true or false, so it can be returned directly.
9.0 is not dangerous. Only scores over 9.0 are.
